crop.notes: The section headline 'Gallagher and His Tape Worm' above 'A Letter from Jack Looney' is outside the clipping; the article text is complete

ocr.notes: Gist readable, many garbled words in the first paragraphs and the letter's opening

title.suggested: Jack Looney Says Gallagher Had a Tapeworm When He Fought Allen

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reprinted Jack Looney's letter to the New York Clipper saying Charley Gallagher had a sixty-foot tapeworm when he fought Tom Allen, and offering to back Gallagher against Allen once well.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads Daily Democrat, Sunday Morning, September 26, 1869; the Globe-Democrat did not exist until 1875

facts.fact: Jack Looney, Charley Gallagher's umpire in his fight with Allen, wrote that Gallagher entered the ring weakened by a tapeworm, passed sixty feet of it in Kansas City after the fight
Jack Looney offered to back Charley Gallagher against Tom Allen for any amount once Gallagher recovered

notes: The letter is dated St. Louis, September 10th, and addressed to Frank Queen of the Clipper
